title: Sturgis-led raid sinks a Russian ship; marshals burn the No Name Key base

tellings.quote: with the with the Cubans launches an assault into Cuba and sinks a Russian ship.

plain: In 1962, a man named Frank Sturgis, who worked with anti-Castro forces, is said to have led Cuban exiles in a raid on Cuba that sank a Russian ship, after which US marshals burned their base on No Name Key, a small island in Florida. A lawyer named Dan Sheehan tells this to Michels without naming a source, and he ties it to Robert F. Kennedy, then the US Attorney General. If true, it would show the US government shutting down its own Cuban raiders after they went too far.
